example.title: Creased
lines: Every roof was once a page. Some still remember the words.
When the wind comes, the whole town rustles.
Do not get it wet.

world.title: Wistful Serenity
lines: The river whispers secrets to the stones.
The figures stand at the crest of the hills.
The trees watch the sunset, then go to sleep.

world.title: Wistful Hollow
lines: The rain whispers secrets through the gaps.
The whispers of the rains bring the woods to life.
Do not stop the rain.

world.title: Cavern
lines: Time is the river that carries us away.
Do not forget the sounds of the earth.
The stars shine down on all the things left here.

world.title: Dawn Garden
lines: Morning is a new beginning.
The first light of the sun warms the land.
In the garden, the birds sing joyfully.
The dew sparkles on the wheat, a delicate mirror in the sun.

world.title: Fortified
lines: The gates are silent and still silent.
The walls are ancient and true.
The castle stands, watchful and alone.

world.title: Silence
lines: The pond mirrors the sky.
The sun rises from the mountain.
A book sits on the ancient tree.

world.title: A Place
lines: The morning sun warms the rugged stone faces.
Birds sing their songs above the still water.
Each rock holds secrets of the earth's past.

world.title: Ethereal
lines: The dewy whispers in the forest’s canopy
The mountain’s silent eye watches the flow
Beneath the sun, the pond’s mirror glints

world.title: Realm of the Ancients
lines: Ancient stones whisper stories of the ages.
The stars shine down on the shadows and dreams.
Guardian spirits watch over the secrets of the earth.

world.title: Lavender
lines: The world is a canvas, painted by the rise of the sun.
Morning dew on grass, like tears from the eyes of the earth.
A gentle breeze, the beginning of a new day.

world.title: island in the clouds
lines: The island rises up from the sea, a sanctuary for nature's own.

world.title: Under the Stars
lines: The stars whispered in the still air.
Night crept silently, like a friend.
Do not lose me here.

world.title: Ethereal Heights
lines: The moonlight flows like a river of silver.
Stones whisper secrets under the gentle breeze.
Time is a dancer lost in the night.
The palace of the moon watches over all.
In the shadows, the wind's soft sigh dances.

world.title: Emerald Oasis
lines: Your heartbeat echoes in the trees.
The sun kisses the lagoon gently.
The ancient tree speaks in whispers.

world.title: Haven
lines: The sun hangs low, setting shadows deep.
The river whispers secrets to the breeze.
Do not fear, for light will always rise.

world.title: Desert Oasis
lines: The desert whispers secrets through the night.
Sunset paints the sky with hues of gold and red.
Silence is the melody of the wind.

world.title: Wanderland
lines: The shadows stretch, the sun sets low, and the forest sighs.
In the mist, a castle stands as ancient as time.
The pond's surface mirrors the twilight's hue.

world.title: Echoes
lines: The whispers of the past echo in my bones.
In the darkness, the fire of hope burns bright.
I am home, no matter how far I roam.

world.title: Cavern
lines: The light from the lamps warms the cold stone.
Only the cat knows the secrets of the cave.
The stones whisper of times long past.

world.title: Fjord
lines: The sea whispers secrets to the rocks.
The sun sets on the distant shore.
Rest in the light of night.
